# TPC-DS-OBT Q81

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT obt.returning_customer_c_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, obt.bill_addr_ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(obt.return_amount_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.returned_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1998 AND obt.returning_addr_ca_address_sk = obt.bill_addr_ca_address_sk) AND channel = 'catalog' GROUP BY obt.returning_customer_c_customer_sk, obt.bill_addr_ca_state) SELECT bill_customer_c_customer_id, bill_customer_c_salutation, bill_customer_c_first_name, bill_customer_c_last_name, bill_addr_ca_street_number, bill_addr_ca_street_name, bill_addr_ca_street_type, bill_addr_ca_suite_number, bill_addr_ca_city, bill_addr_ca_county, bill_addr_ca_state, bill_addr_ca_zip, bill_addr_ca_country, bill_addr_ca_gmt_offset, bill_addr_ca_location_type, ctr_total_return FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt CROSS JOIN customer_total_return AS ctr1 WHERE (ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2 WHERE ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state) AND bill_addr_ca_address_sk = bill_customer_c_current_addr_sk AND bill_addr_ca_state = '0' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = bill_customer_c_customer_sk) AND channel = 'catalog' ORDER BY bill_customer_c_customer_id, bill_customer_c_salutation, bill_customer_c_first_name, bill_customer_c_last_name, bill_addr_ca_street_number, bill_addr_ca_street_name, bill_addr_ca_street_type, bill_addr_ca_suite_number, bill_addr_ca_city, bill_addr_ca_county, bill_addr_ca_state, bill_addr_ca_zip, bill_addr_ca_country, bill_addr_ca_gmt_offset, bill_addr_ca_location_type, ctr_total_return LIMIT 100
```
